description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for 16S rRNA gene sequencing of microbial communities from coral reef ecosystems in the Great Barrier Reef, including spatial, environmental, and sequencing context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the sample or sequencing record.

project_name.descr: Name of the study or project generating the sample.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_type.descr: Sample matrix or material type; examples: seawater, coral mucus, coral tissue, reef sediment, biofilm.

ecosystem.descr: Broad ecosystem context for the sample; expected value: coral reef.

reef_system.descr: Named reef system or region; example: Great Barrier Reef.

site_name.descr: Sampling site name or station identifier.

latitude.descr: Latitude of sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea surface (m).

depth_zone.descr: Depth category or zone; examples: shallow, mesophotic, deep.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier within site or depth stratum.

coral_species.descr: Coral host species associated with the sample, if applicable; use taxonomic name or 'NA' if not host-associated.

host_associated.descr: Indicates whether the sample is associated with a coral host or coral surface environment.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the sampling site in degrees Celsius (°C).

water_ph.descr: Measured water pH at the sampling site (dimensionless).

salinity_psu.descr: Water salinity at the sampling site in practical salinity units (PSU).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L).

phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L).

ammonium_umol_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L).

silicate_umol_l.descr: Silicate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L).

turbidity_ntu.descr: Water turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU).

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L).

weather_condition.descr: Qualitative weather or sea state at sampling time; examples: calm, overcast, windy.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect the sample; examples: syringe filtration, pump filtration, swab, tissue biopsy.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used for microbial collection in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water filtered or sampled in liters (L), if applicable.

preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved after collection; examples: flash frozen, ethanol preserved, RNAlater, dry ice.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol identifier used for nucleic acid extraction.

amplicon_region.descr: 16S rRNA gene region amplified; examples: V3-V4, V4, V4-V5.

forward_primer.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for PCR amplification.

reverse_primer.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for PCR amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; examples: Illumina MiSeq, Illumina NovaSeq.

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing library construction.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or batch identifier.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp).

paired_end.descr: Indicates whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

raw_sequence_accession.descr: Repository accession for raw sequencing data; examples: SRA, ENA, DDBJ accession.

taxonomic_pipeline.descr: Bioinformatics pipeline used for taxonomic assignment; examples: QIIME2, mothur, DADA2.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomy assignment; examples: SILVA, Greengenes, RDP.

otu_asv_method.descr: Method used to generate features; examples: OTU clustering, ASV inference.

alpha_diversity_metric.descr: Alpha diversity measure reported for the sample; examples: observed ASVs, Shannon, Simpson.

beta_diversity_group.descr: Grouping label used for downstream community comparison; examples: depth, site, reef region.

coral_health_context.descr: Observed coral health context at or near the sampling location; examples: healthy, bleached, diseased, stressed.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to the sample, field conditions, anomalies, or deviations from protocol.
